evidence.detail: rs/x is constructed from the scene tile-flag byte[][][] and terrain-height int[][][] arrays and owns the additional per-tile overlay/underlay/shape/rotation/shading work arrays used while building the map.
Its byte-array loaders decode terrain/map chunks and object-location streams, including rotated chunk placement, and write collision state into the R39 CollisionMap[] set.

Object placement resolves ObjectDefinition records and dispatches walls, decorations, ground decorations and general game objects into the R40 Scene while applying corresponding CollisionMap blocking.
The final build pass computes tile colors/lighting, emits tile surfaces into Scene, updates scene planes/bridges and creates Scene occluders from accumulated terrain flags.
This exact responsibility set matches the classic client ObjectManager: tile flags/heights constructor, map/object stream decoding, collision updates and Scene construction.

proposals.note: ObjectManager preserves the classic semantic identity of this terrain/object region builder. Exact v308 behavior is primary authority; historical naming is corroborating evidence.
